document.about: NIST technical paper in NCSLI Measure, 10 pages, three columns. Page 1's first column breaks off mid-sentence over a shaded box of the authors' names and address; the sentence goes on at the top of the second column. A band of notes under the second and third columns stands level with the box's foot.

checks.issue: The author box was read inside the Introduction's first sentence, between `generate a 1 pulse` and `per second (pps) on-time signal`.
checks.text: to continuously generate a 1 pulse per second (pps) on-time signal

checks.issue: A region cut at the band of notes ran through the box: its lower lines were read among the notes' lines.
checks.text: Andrew N. Novick Time and Frequency Division National Institute of Standards and Technology¹ Boulder, CO 80305 USA
